crossRefs.note: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice…
I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest…
I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his…
We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

translations.web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
translations.bsb: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
translations.kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
translations.asv: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.
